rows.item: No official source publishes NFL market prices or prop prices
rows.why: Every market_line / diff / CLV / ROI cell that needs a price is left blank
rows.impact: non-blocking; blanks are structural, nothing inferred

rows.item: Club depth charts are labelled unofficial by the clubs
rows.why: The replacement join (names + ordinals) is a lead from club sites, not league-verified fact
rows.impact: 42 replacement rows and the deficiency index are leads only; no model input reads them
rows.source_label: injury report (the sourced half of the join)

rows.item: Closing snapshot numbers are pending the cycle-close capture
rows.why: The Week-10 cycle has not closed; close rows exist and stay blank until scripts/origin_capture.py close runs pre-kickoff

rows.item: Week-11 injury selector still serves the Week-10 report
rows.why: Week-11 markets are deliberately NOT originated without their injury input
137 finals is not a season; CIs are published with every number and they are wide
rows.impact: non-blocking; no conclusion is drawn from a lone r value

rows.item: Parlay leg-dependence phi is a tiny-sample estimate
rows.why: phi over the evaluated weeks cannot separate dependence from noise
rows.impact: published with n; no pricing decision uses it
